editorial:
Imagine waking up to find your fancy Manhattan life gone in a flash because your husband left you for his acupuncturist. That is exactly what happens to Desiree, a woman who is used to the best of everything and a huge bank account. Because of a strict prenup, she has no money and has to move back to her small hometown in New Jersey. You get to watch her go from wearing designer clothes to getting covered in flour at her dad's bakery. It is a classic fish-out-of-water story that feels like a warm hug, mixing a bit of sadness with a lot of sugary sweetness.

What really works here is the chemistry between the characters and the cozy small-town vibe. While the plot is pretty predictable, the acting keeps it feeling fresh and light. You will love the way Desiree grows from a spoiled wife into someone who actually cares about her community. endingExplained: After spending time in Flemington, Desiree realizes that her old life in the city was empty. She chooses to stay in New Jersey and helps her father's bakery become a huge success. She finds a new, genuine love with a local man who appreciates her for who she is, not her money. She officially lets go of her ex-husband and finds true happiness in her simple, cupcake-filled new life.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves Hallmark style movies and happy endings.
